meta.title: Services for Property Owners | Abdul Halim Vacation Homes
meta.description: Full operation of residential buildings and holiday homes in Dubai: property operations, leasing, guest relations, licensing, portfolio administration and facility maintenance.

hero.title: Full operation of your residential property, handled by one accountable team.
hero.intro: We take on the day-to-day running of residential buildings and holiday homes, from licensing to maintenance, so owners receive a well-kept asset and a steady, compliant operation.

items.title: Property Operations
items.body: Day-to-day running of every unit and common area, with a named manager for each building.

items.title: Home Leasing
items.body: Short-term holiday-home contracts and longer residential leases, managed to keep occupancy steady.

items.title: Guest Relations
items.body: Guest and tenant screening, identity checks, house rules, round-the-clock contact and complaint handling.

items.title: Licensing
items.body: Holiday-home permits, renewals and regulatory filings, handled in-house.

items.title: Portfolio Administration
items.body: Centralised tracking of every unit, lease and permit.

items.title: Facility Maintenance
items.body: Planned and reactive maintenance through vetted contractors, keeping each property at hand-over standard.
